visual_synopsis: Opens in black-and-white with two friends in a living room whose argument escalates into a wrestling fight on a couch and a scolding confrontation; the story then cuts to color with the two men heavily bandaged in a hospital-style bed alongside a red-wigged woman, a funeral procession with a hearse and mourners, further physical confrontations in a courtyard, a bathroom scene, and finally men talking outside a snow-covered stone church.
